lines.speaker: Ham
lines.text: You're the one Kell pulled out of a canton office. You don't look like much of a fighter.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: I'm better at not being seen.

lines.speaker: Ham
lines.text: Fair enough. But if Kelsier's going to run you through pewter drills, you'll want to know how a punch feels before someone throws one for real. Find me later.
